summary: Iter 19 backend + frontend regression for 4-feature ship (MoMo /debit-credit, YouTube sync, Apple Sign-In, Delete Account). BACKEND: 22/22 pytest PASS (100%) — MoMo subscription + VOD both route to POST /public/payments/debit-credit (confirmed in backend.err.log HTTP 201 Created) and persist besoftAttempt='debit_credit'. Merchant safety guard blocks 250798875274 in all 3 normalization variants (250798875274, '+250 798 875 274', 0798875274) on BOTH subscription and VOD paths (400). YouTube admin sync returns ok=true, channelTitle='B&B Kigali 89.7FM', upserted=50; db.shows has 50 source='youtube' docs with youtubeId; db.integration_state.key='youtube_sync' has lastSyncAt. YouTube sync without auth → 401 and non-admin → 403. GET /admin/youtube/status ok. Apple /auth/apple with invalid token → 401 (via apple_auth.verify_apple_identity_token JWKS check). Delete Account throwaway phone +250789000099 flow: create → verify → DELETE /auth/me → 200 {ok:true}; user removed, sessions purged, otp_challenges purged; token no longer authorizes (401). DELETE without token → 401. PayPal subscription + VOD regressions PASS (approveUrl to https://www.paypal.com). Health/shows list/guest-locked-VOD all green. FRONTEND: home loads, BB Kigali branding present, 4 tabs render (Home/Shows/News/Profile), guest browsing works (no login gate), no red-screen on Home. Profile screen has Delete Account (testID=delete-account-btn) + Privacy Policy row + double-confirm Alert. Phone auth screen contains 'Continue with Apple' button (iOS-only guarded in code). Checkout has retry button (testID=momo-retry-btn). CRITICAL REGRESSION: Shows tab crashes with a red screen — 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading toUpperCase)' at app/(tabs)/shows.tsx:110 because the new YouTube-synced show docs store 'categoryId' but NO 'category' field, while the UI does item.category.toUpperCase() unconditionally. This breaks the Shows tab for every user after a YouTube sync. Video/[id] VOD unlock modal has no explicit 'Retry MoMo' button (spec asked for one — user must re-tap the same confirm button).

ui_bugs.issue: RED SCREEN: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading toUpperCase)' at line 110. `item.category.toUpperCase()` throws because YouTube-synced show docs (source='youtube', 50 of them) have field `categoryId` but no `category` string. Every user opening the Shows tab after the sync hits this. Fix: either FE guard `(item.category ?? '').toUpperCase()` OR backend youtube_sync.py should also write `category: 'bbkigali-youtube'` on each show doc so both fields coexist (spec explicitly said 'create category bbkigali-youtube'). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/shows.tsx:110 and /app/backend/youtube_sync.py:183 (only categoryId is set on show docs).
YouTube-synced shows show raw ISO-8601 duration (e.g. 'PT2H44M58S') instead of human format ('2:44:58'). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/shows.tsx:106 renders item.duration verbatim.

Spec asked for an explicit in-app 'Retry MoMo Payment' button on the VOD unlock modal after failure. Current UI (line 271-292) only exposes the initial 'Pay' Pressable — the user has to re-tap the same confirm button; there is no dedicated retry affordance (the checkout.tsx screen DOES have one at line 399 with testID='momo-retry-btn').

action_items: CRITICAL — Fix Shows-tab crash. Preferred: in /app/backend/youtube_sync.py add `category: 'bbkigali-youtube'` (string) alongside `categoryId` when upserting each show doc, matching the legacy show schema. Alternatively (or additionally) in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/shows.tsx line 110 use `(item.category ?? '').toUpperCase()` as a defensive guard.
Format YouTube ISO-8601 duration to HH:MM:SS in the sync (or in the UI). Currently rendering 'PT2H44M58S' verbatim on cards.

Add a dedicated 'Retry MoMo Payment' button in /app/frontend/app/video/[id].tsx failure branch (mirror the checkout.tsx testID='momo-retry-btn' pattern) — spec explicitly required this on BOTH checkout and VOD unlock modal.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 backend features work end-to-end. The blocking frontend issue is a single-line schema mismatch: YouTube-synced shows lack the `category` string field that /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/shows.tsx:110 assumes. Fix in youtube_sync.py (preferred) or add a null-guard in shows.tsx. To reproduce: open http://localhost:3000/, tap the 'Shows' tab in the bottom nav — the red screen appears immediately from the FlatList renderItem. Auth: use admin phone +250794230137 with testCode 123456 (fast path). Run: `cd /app/backend && EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://radio-vod-platform.preview.emergentagent.com MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017 DB_NAME=test_database pytest tests/test_iter19_multifeature.py -v -o addopts='' --tb=short`.
rca_of_issue: Root cause of Shows-tab red screen: /app/backend/youtube_sync.py at line ~183 upserts each show with only `categoryId: <uuid>` (linking to the categories collection). Legacy show docs (Kigali Nights Live, Morning Show Recap, etc.) have a plain-string `category: 'vod'|'podcast'|'interview'` field. The frontend list card at /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/shows.tsx:110 renders `{item.category.toUpperCase()}` unconditionally, so any of the 50 newly-synced YouTube shows in the FlatList triggers a TypeError. Reproduction: (1) call POST /api/admin/youtube/sync as admin (or wait for the 6-hour periodic sync), (2) open the Expo web preview, (3) tap the Shows tab. Mitigation options (main agent): (a) add `category: 'bbkigali-youtube'` to the upsert dict in youtube_sync.py so both fields exist; (b) defensive null-guard on the UI side: `(item.category ?? '').toUpperCase()`. Recommend applying BOTH for defense in depth.
